text: 1.Abide by the relevant policies and decrees formulated by the Chinese government, and the rules and regulations of University. 2.Study hard and have good moral character. Respect the teaching staff and Chinese traditions and customs. 3.Develop scientific attitude in research and study and stress the combination of theory and practice. Have a good command of basic theories and systematic knowledge in the field of Business Administration. 4.Be in good health condition.
